examples.title: Basic data list
examples.description: A list of homogeneous records. DataList is the semantic `<ul role="list">` container; each row is a StackedListItem with a title and trailing meta. Row chrome (padding, dividers, density) is owned by the row, so content stays compactly aligned instead of stretching to the viewport edges.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { DataList } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { StackedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const members = [
    { id: 'alice', name: 'Alice Chen', role: 'Engineer', status: 'Active' },
    { id: 'bob', name: 'Bob Osei', role: 'Designer', status: 'Active' },
    { id: 'carol', name: 'Carol Mwangi', role: 'Product', status: 'Invited' },
  ];
</script>

<DataList items={members} key={(m) => m.id}>
  {#snippet children(member)}
    <StackedListItem>
      {#snippet title()}{member.name}{/snippet}
      {#snippet meta()}{member.role} · {member.status}{/snippet}
    </StackedListItem>
  {/snippet}
</DataList>

examples.title: Day groups with a shared status column
examples.description: groupBy puts consecutive rows under a header band that names a nested list, and statusColumn keeps the status column for rows with nothing to report so titles line up.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import {
    DataList,
    StackedListItem,
    StatusDot,
    type StatusDotWordLabel,
  } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  type Run = {
    id: string;
    day: string;
    dayLabel: string;
    title: string;
    status?: StatusDotWordLabel;
    time: string;
    meta: string;
  };

  const runs: Run[] = [
    {
      id: 'a',
      day: 'today',
      dayLabel: 'Today · Monday, Nov 2',
      title: 'Refund order 4471',
      status: 'Waiting on you',
      time: '10:42 AM',
      meta: 'Chat · Tool runner · waiting 4 min',
    },
    {
      id: 'b',
      day: 'today',
      dayLabel: 'Today · Monday, Nov 2',
      title: 'Schedule tick',
      time: '9:00 AM',
      meta: 'Internal · Interborough started',
    },
    {
      id: 'c',
      day: 'yesterday',
      dayLabel: 'Yesterday · Sunday, Nov 1',
      title: 'Say hello',
      status: 'Done',
      time: '4:12 PM',
      meta: 'Chat · Assistant · 8 s',
    },
  ];
</script>

<DataList
  items={runs}
  key={(run) => run.id}
  statusColumn
  groupBy={(run) => ({ key: run.day, label: run.dayLabel, detail: 'Central time' })}
>
  {#snippet children(run)}
    {#if run.status}
      {@const word = run.status}
      <StackedListItem href={`#${run.id}`} tooltip={run.title}>
        {#snippet status()}<StatusDot {word} />{/snippet}
        {#snippet title()}{run.title}{/snippet}
        {#snippet time()}{run.time}{/snippet}
        {#snippet meta()}{run.meta}{/snippet}
      </StackedListItem>
    {:else}
      <StackedListItem href={`#${run.id}`} tooltip={run.title}>
        {#snippet title()}{run.title}{/snippet}
        {#snippet time()}{run.time}{/snippet}
        {#snippet meta()}{run.meta}{/snippet}
      </StackedListItem>
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</DataList>

examples.title: Empty state fallback
examples.description: When items is empty, the empty snippet renders inside a component-owned `<li class="cinder-data-list-empty">` — centered, muted padding, no inline styles required.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { DataList } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { StackedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const members: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];
</script>

<DataList items={members} key={(m) => m.id}>
  {#snippet children(member)}
    <StackedListItem>
      {#snippet title()}{member.name}{/snippet}
    </StackedListItem>
  {/snippet}
  {#snippet empty()}
    No team members yet.
  {/snippet}
</DataList>

examples.title: A row inserted while you watch
examples.description: insertionAnnouncement makes the list live: a new run appears at the top of its group, a polite live region says "1 new run" and draws it as a status strip above the first group, and the list keeps its place.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import {
    Button,
    DataList,
    StackedListItem,
    StatusDot,
    type StatusDotWordLabel,
  } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  type Run = { id: string; title: string; status: StatusDotWordLabel; time: string; meta: string };

  let runs = $state<Run[]>([
    {
      id: 'refund-4471',
      title: 'Refund order 4471',
      status: 'Waiting on you',
      time: '10:42 AM',
      meta: 'Chat · Tool runner · waiting 4 min',
    },
    {
      id: 'refund-4472',
      title: 'Look up order 4472',
      status: 'Done',
      time: '10:30 AM',
      meta: 'Chat · Tool runner · 14 s',
    },
  ]);

  function startRun() {
    runs = [
      {
        id: 'lookup-4475',
        title: 'Look up order 4475',
        status: 'Running',
        time: '10:45 AM',
        meta: 'Chat · Tool runner · running 12 s',
      },
      ...runs,
    ];
  }
</script>

<Button onclick={startRun}>Start a run</Button>
<DataList
  items={runs}
  key={(run) => run.id}
  groupBy={() => ({ key: 'today', label: 'Today · Monday, Nov 2', detail: 'Central time' })}
  insertionAnnouncement={(count) => `${count} new run${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
>
  {#snippet children(run)}
    <StackedListItem href={`#${run.id}`} tooltip={run.title}>
      {#snippet status()}<StatusDot word={run.status} />{/snippet}
      {#snippet title()}{run.title}{/snippet}
      {#snippet time()}{run.time}{/snippet}
      {#snippet meta()}{run.meta}{/snippet}
    </StackedListItem>
  {/snippet}
</DataList>
